claims.statement: Monitoring uses the canonical missions model; the experimental monitoringJobs model is not registered.
Workbench endpoints are read-only semantic projections of canonical runtime records and do not create a parallel scheduler or data model.
The application opens on one compact role-aware Home with one contextual primary action, explicit decision rationale and progressive actor authority guidance.

The bootstrap response projects a canonical server-issued access profile describing identity, capabilities, prohibited actions, state effects and evidence; the UI does not infer authority from button visibility alone.
The rendered experience uses server-issued capabilities for write affordances, explains actor authority and provides compact mobile, keyboard and touch-safe presentation rules.
Auditor access remains read-only, does not impersonate an administrator, displays an explicit authority map and exposes evidence through the active auditor identity.

The repository contains an executable 18-dimension enterprise assurance model with per-dimension N+15 saturation, universal invariant convergence, source probes, selected runtime stress and explicit falsification; it does not certify deployment controls.
The ICTC 1.4 experience model enumerates 23,328 declared scenarios, freezes at N=23,392 and demonstrates zero novelty in the following 100 model probes.
Deployment certification requires external identity, TLS, storage, backup, malware scanning, observability and accessibility evidence.
